structured.feedback: The description is about 165 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing, and it leaves out weaknesses like dried-up product, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are a length under 200 words, a loose feature/benefit split, and some generic phrasing such as "creative outlet".
